evidence_rules: Counts are planned grouped checks, not executed tests, individual HTTP assertions, branches or percentage coverage.
Direct mappings name intended assertions; result receipts and independent review must establish actual execution and validity.
Supporting mappings cannot close a family by themselves. Missing/fatal/prerequisite cases stay not_run/incomplete.
Artifact/source hashes, actual signed session provenance, cookie cache lifetime, native state/effects, observed browser completion and sanitized canary/response evidence must match.
Any residual vector must remain explicit; a confirmed blocking defect does not silently close unexecuted vectors.

BFCache is enabled by removing Playwright default --disable-back-forward-cache. History traversal is not BFCache proof; only native trusted pageshow persisted:true supports actual restoration. Zero hits retain cached-document behavior as unexercised; actual no-store or other reasons may legitimately exclude eligibility.

pageshow-start private canary and historical navigation Response bytes do not alone prove new server delivery or failed completed recovery. Inspect settled DOM/screenshots, navigation timing and separate actual requests.

families.acceptance: Actual credential login creates signed cookie and independent session; wrong password, locked/inactive user and forbidden origin do not gain authority.
Get-session default versus disableCookieCache after server-side revoke, DB expiry, account deactivation and fresh untouched independent login; inspect no private user/session fields.
list-sessions and list-accounts deny revoked/expired cached subject; no sibling session token or account metadata; independent active user still works.
unlink-account on revoked/expired cached session with two owned accounts causes no deletion; active account positive control separately.
update-user custom HTTP rejects revoked/expired session, forged ownership, unsupported authority fields and cross-origin; authorized reviewed profile read/write still works.
residual_limits: Successor submits representative forged actor/tenant and top-level/nested privilege fields against the current strict schema; it does not enumerate every conceivable input key. Runtime evidence pending.

families.acceptance: update-session forged assurance/user/org/expiry fields rejected with no changed session privilege; no writable additional fields currently configured.
revoke-session foreign token does not revoke other subject; revoke-others preserves caller, new independent login remains functional; no test credential logged.
Core provider endpoints reject anonymous/forged user/account IDs and wrong origin; configured-provider branch and callback state/signature negative evidence labeled separately from hosted positive.
residual_limits: No live/configured Google provider positive token-exchange or configured-provider object-ownership path; current isolated runtime has no live provider credentials. Hosted proof remains external.

families.acceptance: GET/HEAD/OPTIONS/method-denial matrix on auth and UploadThing; HEAD carries no body/private leak and must not bypass guard; OPTIONS public204 metadata only.
residual_limits: Current installed core HEAD dispatch is unsupported404, established with authorized and revoked/expired controls. Other implicit auth method combinations remain source-mapped unless specifically listed; no HEAD-to-GET authentication-guard execution is inferred.

families.acceptance: Guarded /api/me/permissions,/api/me/profile and both current private-media delivery URLs reject revoked/expired/other-tenant cases; no unauthorized writes; permissions from DB fresh.
Role permission removal/restoration and enforced inventory module disable/restoration take effect on next API/action/page request; legitimate independent actor works throughout.

Rendered private page then revoke externally: same tab stale action, focus/visibility return, back/forward and reload do not restore private records or controls from stale authorization. Record each journey separately, both locales.
residual_limits: Back/forward/reload/native focus are planned on selected inventory route in EN/FR; other private UI consumers remain distinct. No instantaneous pushed-revocation obligation is inferred.
BFCache eligibility/use remains an observed runtime condition. No native persisted hit means history navigation may be qualified while cached-document restoration remains unexercised.

families.acceptance: Expiry browser journey and account switch/other-tenant browser contexts cannot reuse private data; authorized positive screenshot/bytes before and after recovery.
residual_limits: Tenant switching remains English-only; selected expiry/permission/module/revocation recovery journeys are planned EN/FR.
BFCache eligibility/use remains an observed runtime condition. No native persisted hit means history navigation may be qualified while cached-document restoration remains unexercised.

families.acceptance: UploadThing public GET/HEAD only router metadata; POST unauthorized/no permission/no module rejected before storage; authorized legacy ingress intentionally denied managed-upload-only.

UploadThing missing/invalid signature, tampered signed body/origin, unknown slug/method/action combos fail without callback side effects; approved synthetic signed callback can reach owned loopback callback sink only and no business writes.
Security/session/audit before-after snapshots classify each intended effect; denied requests cannot modify item/profile/account/role/grant/outbox state or expose any private canary.
residual_limits: Baseline receipts assert business state equality and retain audit/session evidence; reviewers must classify those rows, rather than infer that arbitrary excluded-table changes are allowed.

notes: Unconfigured provider rejection is not positive proof of configured-provider account ownership or token refresh.
